subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers, should OpenClaw support strict relays that reject system/developer prompt messages via a new `systemPromptPlacement` compat key, by extending existing `supportsDeveloperRole` semantics, or not in core?
rationale: The reported failure is real for a relay class, but the repair changes provider request policy and possibly public config surface while related history shows the opposite provider class can break if developer/system defaults move globally.

options.title: Sponsor default-preserving opt-in
options.body: Approve an explicit opt-in compatibility path, whether #92147's `systemPromptPlacement` or a maintainer-chosen equivalent, while preserving current defaults for existing users.

options.title: Reuse existing developer-role compat only
options.body: Require the fix to avoid a new config key by extending `supportsDeveloperRole` or another existing compat surface, accepting that relays rejecting both system and developer in `input` may remain unsupported.

options.title: Decline core relay support
options.body: Close this relay class as unsupported in core and direct users to `openai-completions`, a relay-side workaround, or an external plugin/provider owner.

recommendation.title: Sponsor default-preserving opt-in
recommendation.body: Approve an explicit opt-in compatibility path, whether #92147's `systemPromptPlacement` or a maintainer-chosen equivalent, while preserving current defaults for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a provider/config product-surface decision around the newly extracted `@openclaw/ai` runtime and OpenAI provider docs, where steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal.
